templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from flanked-core by the note-writer: a 19-component, 14-flow left-to-right compiler pipeline (LLVM to DSL to E-graph) runs through one boxed iterative Phase loop and out to HLS-synthesized instructions, a pipeline with a loop, not an engine between bands.
templates.what_to_learn: Box one iterative loop (equality saturation, anti-unification, vectorization, selection) inside a highlighted sub-region of a longer pipeline rather than drawing every pass as a separate top-level stage; the weakness here is that those sub-step boxes carry only short keywords, so a reader needs the matching subsection to interpret them.
